metadata.question: There was a volcanic plume visible over Mount Etna at 1:37 am local time on February 23, 2021. Did the plume go to the western side?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about a volcanic plume at Mount Etna on February 23, 2021 at 1:37 am local time, and whether it went to the western side. Let me break this down: 1. Location: Mount Etna, Sicily, Italy 2. Date/time: February 23, 2021 at 1:37 am local time (which would be UTC+1 or UTC+2 depending on daylight saving) 3. Question: Did the plume go to the western side? For volcanic plumes, I should use satellite imagery that can detect ash/plumes. Good options: - MODIS (Terra/Aqua) - good for thermal and visible detection - VIIRS (Suomi NPP/NOAA-20) - similar to MODIS - Sentinel-2 - high resolution but may not have night coverage - GOES - geostationary but may not cover Europe well Since this is at night (1:37 am), I need sensors that can operate at night: - MODIS (Aqua has ~1:30 am overpass) - VIIRS (Suomi NPP has similar overpass times) - Thermal infrared bands would be best for detecting volcanic plumes at night I'll try VIIRS first since it has good nighttime capabilities and appropriate overpass times. For the analysis: 1. Get VIIRS imagery around that time 2. Look for thermal anomalies or plume signatures 3. Determine plume direction relative to the volcano The key is to check if the plume extends westward from the volcano. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const etna = ee.Geometry.Point([14.999, 37.751]); // Mount Etna coordinates const date = '2021-02-23'; const startTime = '2021-02-23T00:00:00'; // Local time is UTC+1, so 1:37 am = 00:37 UTC const endTime = '2021-02-23T01:00:00'; // Narrow window around the time // 2. Data Acquisition - Try VIIRS for nighttime plume detection let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP02IMG') .filterBounds(etna) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS Images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { // Try MODIS as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD021KM') .filterBounds(etna) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); const modisCount = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Images found: ${modisCount}`); if (modisCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Get the first image and check for valid pixels const image = collection.first(); // Use M12 band (3.7μm) which is good for nighttime thermal detection const thermalBand = 'M12'; const plumeImage = image.select(thermalBand); // Check pixel count around Etna const buffer = etna.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around Etna const pixelCount = plumeImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(thermalBand).getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in 50km buffer: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Analyze plume direction // Create sectors to detect plume direction const westSector = etna.buffer(30000).intersection( ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [14.499, 37.451], [14.499, 38.051], [14.999, 38.051], [14.999, 37.451] ]) ); const eastSector = etna.buffer(30000).intersection( ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [14.999, 37.451], [14.999, 38.051], [15.499, 38.051], [15.499, 37.451] ]) ); // Calculate mean brightness temperature in each sector const westTemp = plumeImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: westSector, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(thermalBand).getInfo(); const eastTemp = plumeImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: eastSector, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(thermalBand).getInfo(); console.log(`West sector temp: ${westTemp ? westTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`East sector temp: ${eastTemp ? eastTemp.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (westTemp === null || eastTemp === null || isNaN(westTemp) || isNaN(eastTemp)) { console.log("C3"); } else { // If west sector is significantly warmer (plume signature), answer Yes const tempDiff = westTemp - eastTemp; console.log(`Temperature difference (W-E): ${tempDiff.toFixed(2)}`); if (tempDiff > 2.0) { // Threshold for plume detection console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
